mono.purpose: Code block, badges, version tag, status labels.

shadows.name: code-elevation
shadows.purpose: The hero code showcase at rest — the one genuinely elevated surface.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and hover state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled CTA on the page — solid Terminal Cyan, used for the highest-priority action only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 8px; background: #00F0FF; color: #05050A; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,240,255,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00F0FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for secondary actions (View on GitHub) — no fill, no gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(240,244,248,0.16); color: #F0F4F8; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(240,244,248,0.6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0F4F8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Flat surface, no glass/blur — depth on hover comes from a border shift and lift only.
components.html:
🛡

components.css: .ds-feature-card { padding: 2rem; border-radius: 12px; background: #0D0D14; border: 1px solid rgba(240,244,248,0.08); transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-feature-card:hover { border-color: rgba(240,244,248,0.2); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-feature-icon { font-size: 1.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .ds-feature-card h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: #F0F4F8; margin: 0 0 0.75rem; } .ds-feature-card p { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #8B9BB4; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Version Badge
components.description: Monospace status badge — reinforces the terminal personality outside the code block.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.25); color: #00F0FF; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 400; background: transparent; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #8B9BB4; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #F0F4F8; } .ds-nav-link.active { color: #00F0FF; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a terminal session that's actually running, not a marketing template pretending to be technical. The code showcase in the hero is the credibility anchor and the only genuinely elevated surface on the page; everything else is built to feel like output from the same machine, not decoration bolted onto a SaaS shell. This explicitly rejects the previous build's gradient-clipped headline text, glass panels on nearly every card, and ambient blurred color blobs. Vibrancy now comes from restraint: cyan and violet stay strong where they appear, but they appear on purpose, in one or two places.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace carries badges, labels, and the version string, not just the code block.
Exactly one surface on the page gets glass/blur: the code showcase.
Cyan and violet are rationed to the hero region; section headings and cards use solid neutrals.
Status color (green/amber) communicates real roadmap state, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Elevated Surface Rule
rules.body: Glass/blur is permitted on exactly one element: the hero code showcase. Everything else is flat with a 1px border.

rules.name: The Rationed Accent Rule
rules.body: Cyan and violet together appear in at most two page regions. Section headings and body copy use Signal White or Slate Mist, never a gradient clip.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Text Rule
rules.body: No background-clip: text anywhere. Every heading, logo, and label is a solid, single color.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every card and panel outside the hero is flat: solid terminal-surface background, 1px border, no blur, no shadow at rest.

dos: Do use Terminal Cyan as the single accent for anything interactive or currently-true.
Do keep the code showcase as the only glass/blur surface on the page.
Do use solid Signal White for every heading and logo mark.
Do let JetBrains Mono carry badges, the version tag, and status labels.
donts: Don't use background-clip: text gradients on the logo, hero title, or section titles.
Don't apply backdrop-filter / translucent glass to feature cards, roadmap panels, or the mobile nav.
Don't use ambient blurred color blobs as page-background atmosphere.
Don't color feature-card icons in a rainbow rotation.
Don't reintroduce a second accent gradient on the progress-bar fill.
